title: The Queen of Sheba Visits Solomon

questions.question: Why did the Queen of Sheba come to Solomon?
options: To test him with hard questions
questions.correctAnswer: To test him with hard questions
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:1 (ESV): "Now when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon... she came to test him with hard questions."

questions.question: What was the Queen of Sheba's reaction to Solomon's wisdom and wealth?
options: There was no more breath in her
questions.correctAnswer: There was no more breath in her
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:5 (ESV): "...there was no more breath in her."

questions.question: What did the Queen of Sheba give to Solomon?
options: 120 talents of gold, spices, and precious stones
questions.correctAnswer: 120 talents of gold, spices, and precious stones
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:10 (ESV): "Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices and precious stones..."

questions.question: What was Solomon's throne made of?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:18 (ESV): "The king also made a great ivory throne and overlaid it with the finest gold."

questions.question: What was the annual weight of gold that came to Solomon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:14 (ESV): "Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was 666 talents of gold..."

questions.question: What did Solomon make from the almug wood?
options: Supports for the house of the LORD and lyres and harps
questions.correctAnswer: Supports for the house of the LORD and lyres and harps
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:12 (ESV): "And the king made of the almug wood supports for the house of the LORD... and lyres and harps..."

questions.question: Silver was considered how valuable in Solomon's days?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:27 (ESV): "And the king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stone..."

questions.question: What did Solomon give the Queen of Sheba?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:13 (ESV): "And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all that she desired..."

questions.question: Every how many years did the fleet of ships come bringing riches?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:22 (ESV): "...once every three years the fleet of ships of Tarshish used to come bringing gold, silver..."

questions.question: How many lions stood on the steps of the throne?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:20 (ESV): "...and twelve lions stood there, one on each end of a step on the six steps."

questions.question: What kind of wood did the fleet of Hiram bring from Ophir?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:11 (ESV): "Moreover, the fleet of Hiram... brought from Ophir a very great amount of almug wood..."

questions.question: What animals were brought by the ships of Tarshish besides gold and silver?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:22 (ESV): "...bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks."

questions.question: How many chariots and horsemen did Solomon gather?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:26 (ESV): "And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen..."

questions.question: From where did Solomon's horses come?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:28 (ESV): "And Solomon's import of horses was from Egypt and Kue..."

questions.question: How much did a chariot imported from Egypt cost?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 10:29 (ESV): "A chariot could be imported from Egypt for 600 shekels of silver..."

key_verse_text: Blessed be the LORD your God, who has delighted in you and set you on the throne of Israel! Because the LORD loved Israel forever, he has made you king, that you may execute justice and righteousness. (ESV)
